comment: GAF label manifest template. Instantiate as ai-factory/labels.json and let FACTORY_LABELS.template.yml (as .github/workflows/factory-labels.yml) create and sync them — works even where the agent has no label API, and keeps labels in sync forever. Rules: create ALL labels the profile enables and NONE it doesn't (no notifications → no 'unsubscribed'; no voting → nothing vote-related). Missing labels are the most common silent setup failure. Owner-maintained; the Factory may not edit this file (RULES A4).
renames_comment: Renames are applied BEFORE the sync loop and preserve a label's identity, so it stays attached to issues already carrying it (create-new-plus-delete-old would strip it from history). Each entry is a no-op once applied — safe to leave in place. Never rename onto an existing name.
pipeline_labels_comment: The state machine. Always created. Extension roles add their triple: <role>:queued/in-process/executed.

labels.name: coder:queued
labels.description: In the AI Coder's queue (added by the Architect on approval)

labels.name: coder:in-process

labels.name: coder:executed
labels.description: Built, verified and shipped per the ship definition

conditional_labels_comment: Append into 'labels' only what the profile enables. W10 notifications → { name: 'unsubscribed', color: 'EEEEEE', description: 'Submitter opted out of notifications' }. W14 priority lane → { name: 'priority:owner', color: 'D4A017', description: 'Filed by the owner — picked first by both roles' }.
taxonomy_comment: W13, if chosen. type:* — exactly one per idea; keep the set mutually exclusive or filtering stops meaning anything; scope type:infra to product build config, explicitly NEVER the Factory's own files. area:* — GENERATE from the Phase 0 file map (label per source file/surface + one catch-all for project config & docs); avoid names colliding with the product's own user-facing vocabulary. flag:* — only flags that CHANGE ROLE BEHAVIOUR (e.g. flag:privacy → Architect must justify the privacy invariant, Coder must report on it; flag:placeholder → pairs with the W15 gate).
